lead: Rating a reply: thumbs up / thumbs down toggle buttons. After a thumbs down, a small form can ask why (multi-select reasons + a comment), and once sent it is replaced by a short confirmation. The caller owns the rating; the component only handles the interaction and the screen reader texts.

reasons.title: Ask why
reasons.description: Pass `reasons` and a thumbs down expands a form; once sent, the form collapses and a confirmation appears.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.group: The button group (`role=group`) and the two buttons (`data-value`: up / down; `aria-pressed`)
styling.form: The form shown after a thumbs down
styling.reasons: The reasons' fieldset, its legend and each checkbox
styling.comment: The comment field and the send button
styling.thanks: The confirmation after sending (`role=status`, always in the DOM, hidden while empty)
